_comment: Fee configs per chain: the immutable stray config the settlement is constructed with, the FeeDefaults address once deployed, and the append-only history of the defaults published there. A CI MIRROR of FeeDefaults, not its authority: `contracts/test/FeeConfigsJson.t.sol` recomputes every hash, `app/scripts/check-fee-configs.ts` compares this file with the chain's DefaultsSet logs. Append only. Rates are fractions of 1e18 as decimal strings. `Deploy.s.sol` reads the stray config and the LAST history entry (the initial defaults it publishes). Spec: docs/specs/2026-10-03-fee-config-hash.md section 2.4.
_rates: handover = P1 feeRateIn (tokenIn, gas cover), output = P2 feeRate (tokenOut, on top), proceeds = P3 feeRateProceeds (out of the maker's proceeds). Initial values per the owner's defaults: handover 0, output 0.5% (5e15), proceeds 0; warn 1% (1e16) at every point.
